title: Hot Wheels Battle Force 5
description: In this series based on the legendary toy brand, an elite team of drivers in five ultracool, ultrafast vehicles are given a mission to save Earth from two evil species of alien invaders, the Sark and the Vandals. Led by Vert Wheeler, Battle Force 5 take on the predators in unique BattleZones, engaging their weaponized supervehicles to secure the key in each zone that, in the hands of the Sark and Vandals, unlocks a secure pathway to Earth.

episodes_data.title: Hot Wheels Battle Force 5 Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Vert Wheeler is pulled into another dimension to race in a battle against two fighting groups.

episodes_data.title: Hot Wheels Battle Force 5 Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: The newly assembled team practices survival skills and controlling their vehicles.

episodes_data.title: Hot Wheels Battle Force 5 Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Agura becomes frustrated with her teammates' hang ups, especially Spinner's fear of germs.

episodes_data.title: Hot Wheels Battle Force 5 Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: While training in a BattleZone, the team decides to infiltrate a Sark factory.

episodes_data.title: Hot Wheels Battle Force 5 Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Zoom is captured after feeling neglected by the team.

episodes_data.title: Hot Wheels Battle Force 5 Season 1 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: In order to obtain the next BattleKey, Spinner and Sherman work together and face off against an evil junkyard dog.

episodes_data.title: Hot Wheels Battle Force 5 Season 1 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: Vert goes undercover as a Vandal to uncover their secrets of the BattleZone.

episodes_data.title: Hot Wheels Battle Force 5 Season 1 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Stanford becomes friends with a shifty character named Zug. The Battle Force 5 is worried that he might be losing focus.

episodes_data.title: Hot Wheels Battle Force 5 Season 1 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: Stanford discovers that he's the descendant of a famed multiverse explorer and ruler. This inspires him to challenge Battle Force 5's leadership structure and make a peace pact with The Vandals, but can they be trusted?!

episodes_data.title: Hot Wheels Battle Force 5 Season 1 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: Zoom is injured while the Battle Force 5 is battling in a Battle Zone. Now the rest of the team must find a plant to get the antidote for Zoom.

episodes_data.title: Hot Wheels Battle Force 5 Season 1 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: After Zeke's brain is encoded with Battle Force 5 secrets, he joins the team on a mission in a BattleZone.

episodes_data.title: Hot Wheels Battle Force 5 Season 1 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: During a strange solar flare, something goes awry in the Multiverse and Battle Force 5 find themselves face-to-face with their evil twins! This anti-Battle Force 5 team is so nasty that our heroes must join together with an unlikely ally if they want to keep their bad-selves away from Earth!

episodes_data.title: Hot Wheels Battle Force 5 Season 1 Episode 13
episodes_data.description: An individual from Zoom's past arrives in Handler Corners to take Zoom back home so that he can fulfill his destiny as the "Chosen One.

episodes_data.title: Hot Wheels Battle Force 5 Season 1 Episode 14
episodes_data.description: Battle Force 5 must defend "Zeke's Diner" from the Sarks when the diner has been teleported into a BattleZon

episodes_data.title: Hot Wheels Battle Force 5 Season 1 Episode 15
episodes_data.description: Vert and Zoom must compete in a "Cage of Doom" against the Vandals while trying to outwit a BattleZone with its fiendish agenda.

episodes_data.title: Hot Wheels Battle Force 5 Season 1 Episode 16
episodes_data.description: After Spinner takes control of a Zentner, Zemerik captures him and forces him to show him the battle moves. Zemerik then tricks Spinner into using the techniques on the Battle Force 5!

episodes_data.title: Hot Wheels Battle Force 5 Season 1 Episode 17
episodes_data.description: A super-cold BattleZone enables the Sark's computerized brains to work faster than ever! As a result, Agura and Stanford must put aside their rivalry to battle the hyper-accelerated Sark, a Sark Tangler and a giant Yeti!

episodes_data.title: Hot Wheels Battle Force 5 Season 1 Episode 18
episodes_data.description: A BattleZone that will give the battlekey only if the Battle Force 5 win a game of BattleKey Scoccer, and the BattleKey is the ball.

episodes_data.title: Hot Wheels Battle Force 5 Season 1 Episode 19
episodes_data.description: Hatch has built a time-stopping device that will not only leave the portal open for a Vandal invasion, but freeze time in Handler's Corners.

episodes_data.title: Hot Wheels Battle Force 5 Season 1 Episode 20
episodes_data.description: Sherman and Spinner's obsession over gathering Battlezone artifacts prove to be extremely dangerous when their souvenir collection comes to life.

episodes_data.title: Hot Wheels Battle Force 5 Season 1 Episode 21
episodes_data.description: Vert is trapped inside a giant nest of mechanical wasps. Stanford must lead Battle Force 5 to keep the Vandals from reaching Earth while figuring out a way to get Vert out before it's too late...

episodes_data.title: Hot Wheels Battle Force 5 Season 1 Episode 22
episodes_data.description: The Battle Force 5 and the Vandals are forced to fight against each other, and fellow teammates, in a battlezone run by a deranged, red Sark named Tors-10.

episodes_data.title: Hot Wheels Battle Force 5 Season 1 Episode 23
episodes_data.description: Stanford gets a hard lesson about self-relience as the Battle Force 5 must stabilize the Cycloid Zone to prevent the multiverse from collapsing. However, a swarm of energy leeches prove to be a considerable obstacle, as they can drain energy from their vehicles and equipment.

episodes_data.title: Hot Wheels Battle Force 5 Season 1 Episode 24
episodes_data.description: When Sage needs to be updated, she is taken to a battlezone in the Mobi. But while downloading new files, the team encounters Zemerik who is trying to take control of both Sage and the Mobi.

episodes_data.title: Hot Wheels Battle Force 5 Season 1 Episode 25
episodes_data.description: Tired of constantly being defeated by Battle Force 5, the Vandals and the Sark join forces to form an 'Axis of Evil,' and fake their demise in a plan to seize the Battle Keys. Meanwhile, the BF5 try to find a solution to Sage's dependence on the Mobi.

episodes_data.title: Hot Wheels Battle Force 5 Season 2 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Krytus frees the rest of his team and the Battle Force 5 must master the fusion process in order to defeat the Red Sentient 5. The combination SkyKnife debuts.

episodes_data.title: Hot Wheels Battle Force 5 Season 2 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: The Battle Force 5 search a Mobi wreck for important Sentient Data Logs. The problem is that the wreck is at the bottom of the Vandal Ocean. The combination Tangler Command Center debuts.

episodes_data.title: Hot Wheels Battle Force 5 Season 2 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: A new Vandal shows up and challenges Kalus for the title of Vandal Warlord: Grimian! The combination SmashClaw debuts.

episodes_data.title: Hot Wheels Battle Force 5 Season 2 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Battle Force 5 learn from Zemerik that there is a rebellion against the Red Sentients on one of the Red Sentient moons. Tezz Volitov joins the Battle Force 5! The Splitwire debuts.

episodes_data.title: Hot Wheels Battle Force 5 Season 2 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: The team have to search for and destroy the Double-Helix Crystal. Stanford must overcome his insecurity whenever he fails, and Vert learns that he plays an important role in a Sentient legend called the "Crimson One". The combination SonicSlash debuts.

episodes_data.title: Hot Wheels Battle Force 5 Season 2 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: The Battle Force 5 decide to hunt down the Red Sentients' re-spawn chambers. Tezz must overcome his arrogance as Sage deals with Stanford's superstition. The combination ShockBlade debuts.

episodes_data.title: Hot Wheels Battle Force 5 Season 2 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: When the team escapes into a desolate zone, they discover a Diad collecting Blue Sentient shells. But when the Diad is captured by a pursuing Kyburi, they must rescue him from the Red Sentient homeworld before the Reds learn of his mission.

episodes_data.title: Hot Wheels Battle Force 5 Season 2 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: The team must locate a terraforming device which could restore Blue Sentient civilization, and the Ice Zone it's in prompts Vert to bring in a new recruit. A.J. Dalton joins the Battle Force 5! The GearSlammer and the combination RigSaw debut.

episodes_data.title: Hot Wheels Battle Force 5 Season 2 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: The Battle Force 5 search for a way into the Red Sentient Homeworld, only to end up on the Vandal homeworld. Tezz learns compassion and to be more of a team player, as he and Vert discover the Vandals' most important secret: their vehicles are being built by an enslaved race of super-engineers.

episodes_data.title: Hot Wheels Battle Force 5 Season 2 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: When a freak accident causes Sherman and Grimian to switch minds, the Battle Force 5 must rescue Sherman from the Vandals and pull himself together before Grimian relays Earth's coordinates to Krytus.

episodes_data.title: Hot Wheels Battle Force 5 Season 2 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: Battle Force 5 must enlist the aid of the Order of the Flying Fists to drive the Red Sentients away from Earth. Zoom's former master is more than what he seems.

episodes_data.title: Hot Wheels Battle Force 5 Season 2 Episode 13
episodes_data.description: To prevent Krytus from locating Sage, Battle Force 5 enlist the aid of pro racer and Indianapolis 500 winner Dan Wheldon in order to destroy the scanner that's being used to search the Multiverse.

episodes_data.title: Hot Wheels Battle Force 5 Season 2 Episode 14
episodes_data.description: Battle Force 5 meet Rawkus, a golem responsible for maintaining the balance of the Multiverse. Can Zoom gain his trust when the Red Sentients steal his Power Core Stone?

episodes_data.title: Hot Wheels Battle Force 5 Season 2 Episode 15
episodes_data.description: Rawkus brings Vert and Zoom to the Shadow Zone to find the lost minds of the Blue Sentients. The key, however, lies within Sage.

episodes_data.title: Hot Wheels Battle Force 5 Season 2 Episode 16
episodes_data.description: The Battle Force 5 must find and rescue the legendary and nearly extinct Magmatrox before the Red Sentients hunt it down!

episodes_data.title: Hot Wheels Battle Force 5 Season 2 Episode 17
episodes_data.description: The Battle Force 5 race against time to save Sage's mentor, Sol.

episodes_data.title: Hot Wheels Battle Force 5 Season 2 Episode 18
episodes_data.description: Under the pretense of stopping Krytus from upgrading the Red Sark, the Battle Force 5 ally with Zemerik on a mission to an ancient Sark Factory. However, Zemerik has other plans for the factory. Meanwhile, a lightning strike permanently fuses the Buster and Tangler.

episodes_data.title: Hot Wheels Battle Force 5 Season 2 Episode 19
episodes_data.description: Vert is reunited with his long lost father! After catching up on their relationship, he leads the Battle Force 5 to a Red Sentient Mobi that Tors-10 was constructing.

episodes_data.title: Hot Wheels Battle Force 5 Season 2 Episode 20
episodes_data.description: Vert gets trapped in the Shadow Zone with Krytus and are forced to work together to get out! If not, the entire Multiverse will be destroyed!

episodes_data.title: Hot Wheels Battle Force 5 Season 2 Episode 21
episodes_data.description: The Battle Force 5 are transported 1,000,000 years back to the Sentients' distant past! Not only must they battle their way back home in an ancient gladitorial game, but they must make certain history unfolds the way it was originally supposed to.

episodes_data.title: Hot Wheels Battle Force 5 Season 2 Episode 22
episodes_data.description: The Battle Force 5 learn of Grimian's alliance with Krytus! Meanwhile, Tezz's scientific curiosity gets him captured by the Vandals!

episodes_data.title: Hot Wheels Battle Force 5 Season 2 Episode 23
episodes_data.description: Vert must work with Krytus to prevent Sage from creating a doomsday device that will end the Multiverse! But is this really the truth? The secret to the Red Sentients' Re-Spawn technology is revealed.

episodes_data.title: Hot Wheels Battle Force 5 Season 2 Episode 24
episodes_data.description: Pursued by the Red Sentients, Zemerik and Zug flee to the Torborian Badlands. While Krytus pursues him, the Battle Force 5 seek vital information from Zemerik's hard-drive that would mean the end of the Sark!

episodes_data.title: Hot Wheels Battle Force 5 Season 2 Episode 25
episodes_data.description: When the Vandals attack the Kharamanos homeworld, the Battle Force 5 must help the Kharamanos stop the Vandals once and for all!

episodes_data.title: Hot Wheels Battle Force 5 Season 2 Episode 26
episodes_data.description: The war with the Red Sentients comes to its climax, as Krytus unfreezes the Red Sentient population by releasing a beta decay wave from a destroyed Battle Zone. At the same time, the Blue Sentient shells are rediscovered as the BF5 attempt to revive the Blue Sentient race.
